gates.requirement: Exact disease/trait definition, direction, controls, tier, ancestry, sex/subgroup, source release; no weaker-phenotype relabeling
Genome-wide signed statistics include null measurements; complete download/hash/schema/row validation, not header/range proof
Verified effect allele and scale; finite beta/valid positive OR; positive SE or valid signed statistic; P encoding/test and N resolved
Native assembly/reference and exact allelic contrast verified; deterministic duplicate/palindromic/indel rules; no rsID-only join
LD release, cohort/subgroup, ancestry, sample N, imputation, dosages/covariates and signed counted allele documented
All retained variants share exact ordered signed LD; missingness/attrition and lead/strong-variant losses audited; no universal coverage percent invented
Triangle reconstruction, scaling/diagonal, symmetry, range, PSD/rank/condition and distance bands verified under frozen precision tolerances; no silent repairs
Per-variant case/control/nominal/effective N, test and cohort weights match approved likelihood; no automatic Neff substitution
Future z/R conditional diagnostics reviewed; no universal lambda threshold or fit-improving allele flip
Cohort overlap/repeated releases/controls cataloged; no unsupported independent replication or meta-combination
GWAS-only deterministic intervals, MHC/complex regions excluded/deferred, boundary/long-range coverage checked
User authorization plus pinned packages/binaries/environment/options/seeds and full signed input/LD freeze
Future convergence, cap sensitivity, CS purity, search/ELBO and instability assessed; method agreement does not fix input errors

locus_design.complex_loci: Defer if long-range/multisignal/structural/boundary/size conditions exceed frozen validated plan; no memory-motivated trimming

locus_design.window_rule: plus/minus 1.5Mb, chromosome clipped, transitive overlap merge; dense nonsignificant rows retained
